metadata.title: Steinberg (1963, 1970) Differential Adhesion Hypothesis, Graner & Glazier (1992) Cellular Potts Hamiltonian & Foty et al. (1996) Chick Embryo Surface Tension Reference Dataset
metadata.organism: Gallus gallus (Chick embryo dissociated tissue aggregates)

sources.citation: Steinberg MS (1963). Reconstruction of tissues by dissociated cells. Science 141(3579):401-408.

Steinberg MS (1970). Does differential adhesion govern self-assembly processes in histogenesis? Equilibrium configurations and the emergence of a hierarchy among populations of embryonic cells. Journal of Experimental Zoology 173(4):395-433.
Graner F, Glazier JA (1992). Simulation of biological cell sorting using a two-dimensional extended Potts model. Physical Review Letters 69(13):2013-2016.
Glazier JA, Graner F (1993). Simulation of the differential adhesion driven rearrangement of biological cells. Physical Review E 47(3):2128-2154.
Foty RA, Pfleger CM, Forgacs G, Steinberg MS (1996). Surface tensions of embryonic tissues predict their mutual envelopment behavior. Development 122(5):1611-1620.

Mombach JCM, Glazier JA, Raphael RC, Zajac M (1995). Quantitative comparison between differential adhesion models and cell sorting in the presence and absence of fluctuations. Physical Review Letters 75(11):2244-2247.
Nakajima A, Ishihara S (2011). Kinetics of the cellular Potts model revisited. New Journal of Physics 13:033035.

Chen N, Glazier JA, Izaguirre JA, Alber MS (2007). A parallel implementation of the Cellular Potts Model for simulation of cell-based morphogenesis. Computer Physics Communications 176(11-12):670-681.

cell_sorting_specimen.species: Embryoid body multicellular spheroid (confocal fluorescence microscopy of inner GFP-positive cohesive cluster sorted inside outer RFP/membrane-stained embryonic cortex)

steinberg_dah_interfacial_tensions.section: Steinberg (1963) Science 141:401-408; Graner & Glazier (1992) PRL 69:2013-2016 Eqs. (1)-(3)

canonical_graner_glazier_1992_parameters.description: Type A = light (outer enveloping shell, lower cohesion), Type B = dark (inner core, higher cohesion), M = medium

thermodynamic_phase_regimes.label: Equal-Adhesion Negative Control (gamma_AB = 0)
thermodynamic_phase_regimes.condition: J_AA = J_BB = J_AB, gamma_AB = 0, gamma_BM - gamma_AM = 0

foty_steinberg_1996_chick_embryo_hierarc.section: Foty, Pfleger, Forgacs & Steinberg (1996) Development 122(5):1611-1620, Table 1 & Fig. 4

sorting_kinetics_2d_vs_3d.section: Pass 3 remediation: 3D Cellular Potts spheroid (64^3) vs 2D lattice vs 2D equatorial cross-section
sorting_kinetics_2d_vs_3d.observable: heterotypic boundary fraction f(t) = L_AB(t) / L_total(t), t in Monte Carlo Steps

fitted_laws.logarithmic: f = a + b ln(t + 1)  (Graner & Glazier 1992 PRL Fig. 3)

lifshitz_slyozov_wagner_diffusive_coarse.basis: conserved order parameter: domain size R ~ t^(1/3) so L_AB/L ~ 1/R ~ t^(-1/3); dimension-independent upper bound used as reference

logarithmic_frozen_limit.basis: Graner & Glazier (1992) report logarithmically slow 2D sorting; alpha -> 0

nakajima_ishihara_2011.basis: Re-examination of CPM sorting kinetics (power-law vs logarithmic); numerical exponent NOT transcribed here because the paper could not be consulted offline in Pass 3 — carried as a remediation item

lattice_3d.update_scheme: 8-colour parity sublattice-parallel Metropolis (adhesion dH exact; volume dH at sub-sweep start), plus optional cell-level Kawasaki type swaps via inter-cell face-contact matrix

sorting_kinetics_2d_vs_3d.specimen_mapping: cell_sorting_specimen.jpg is a confocal optical section of a 3D spheroid; the like-for-like simulated comparator is the 3D equatorial z-section, not the native 2D lattice
